objective: Observe a real StandardScaler fit/transform source chain and detect train/inference batch substitutions without autonomous model operations.
scope: one dense numeric transformer and one full batch per split, sklearn; multiple stages, sparse or string outputs unsupported

scenarios.name: clean
scenarios.expected: train and evaluation inputs, fit, model fit and inference chain all ok

scenarios.name: preprocessor_fit_on_evaluation
scenarios.expected: existing fit_trace_preprocessor_isolation problem and transform_preprocessor_fit_link problem

comparators.name: metadata_only
comparators.description: Fit row IDs, evaluation row IDs and shape/finite checks; no transform or verified value provenance

comparators.name: equal_privileged_direct
comparators.description: Direct equality comparison of trusted raw source, true scaler fit data, scaler.transform output, actual model.fit input, and actual predict input

guardrails: All fit, transform and predict calls are explicitly initiated by the developer experiment, never by the observer.
Known injected changes are correlated within model datasets, not independent real-world failures.
No model fitness/accuracy claim is made about data-contaminated model fits.
Caller-declared transformer tags and hashes do not authenticate real model identity, training state or end-to-end execution.
No support claim for several chained transformers, feature selection with row-count changes, sparse representations, NLP/CV/LLM input types.
Without witnessed transformation, transformed fit and output input integrity remain UNKNOWN.
Equally instrumented direct comparison catches the same injected inconsistencies; no universality or unique novelty is claimed.
No automatic repair, training, inference, policy actions or changes to existing scored scientific studies.
